scenes.setting: Justice teaches Fors the acting method; The Sun buys the Seven Gods from three sellers with answered questions — and his creation myth names the eight ancient gods, among them the King of Demonic Wolves Flegrea: the very word from Klein's advancement ravings, 'the Evernight Demonic Wolf'
